summary: X4 Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 8, 2026, disclosing that it posted an updated corporate presentation on its website, attached as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The presentation covers the mavorixafor chronic neutropenia program, the ongoing 4WARD Phase 3 study, regulatory timelines, prior organizational restructuring, and patent runway. With no special-situation event, the filing is a routine corporate update; the risk-arb angle is limited to clinical and financing catalysts rather than deal mechanics.
